note: The parity mask is SUFFICIENT ONLY under the strict alternating format.  A 1-bit explicit role channel is format-independent and is the minimal sufficient statistic. This is a scope correction to NT31, NOT a new claim that the architecture beats any baseline.  Two extra honest findings: (i) with no role mask, filler tokens IMPLICITLY suppress the spurious peak, so role necessity is layout dependent, not unconditional; (ii) putting A and b in two orthogonal code subspaces with a fixed linear layer projection does NOT remove the ambiguity and fails.
